div.head: VIII Atr 11
div.ab: And ciricsceat gelæste man be Martinus mæssan.
And ciricsceat gelæste man be Martinus mæssan.
And ciricsceat gelæste man be Martinus mæssan.
Und Kirchensteuer sei zum Martinusfest entrichtet;
And let church-scot be paid by Martinmas;
And church dues shall be rendered by Martinmas.
And Church dues are to be paid by the Feast of Saint Martin.
